We need craft files but lack repo conventions/callers. Need infer likely TS. Could create self-contained exported API, docs. Yet "existing callers" no scope integration allowed. Target only new file. Need robust implementation. Need know likely lint style. Build class/function.

Design injectable clock. Sliding window failures threshold. Need distinguish denied attempts? "open cooldown reject requests (no effect)" likely decisions. API: createRateCircuitBreaker options, breaker.canRequest(now?), recordFailure, recordSuccess, onRequest? Existing callers unknown. Could export flexible canonical.

Finite deterministic:
closed failures timestamps window, success clears? "closed accumulates window failures" likely failure count. Sliding window old failures expire. Legal subsequent window no false trip: On legal calls perhaps successes reset consecutive? Phrase "窗口滑动使旧失败过期" means timestamps.
Threshold transition: upon reaching threshold? Threshold likely >= threshold opens. Pure failures less threshold.
open cooldown rejects. At exactly cooldown ends transitions half-open, only single probe allowed.
half-open probe success closes and clears failures; failure opens reset cooldown.
Concurrency single probe atomically in JS sync.

Could include `beforeRequest` returning allow/deny and `recordFailure/recordSuccess`. No effects if denied. A single `handle` maybe.

Need ensure first failure reaching threshold opens. API docs.

Use injected clock number | function. Ensure times monotonic and finite? Determinism. Clock can return ms. State transition lazy. API:
export type ...
export function createRateCircuitBreaker(options): RateCircuitBreaker
class perhaps.

`allowRequest(at?)`: if closed true; open if elapsed>=cooldown => half-open, reserve probe true else false. half-open false if probeInFlight.
Potential stale attempts after cooldown? failures recorded only allowed calls. Caller might record failure without allow. Need methods.

`recordFailure(at?)`: closed push failure; prune; if length >= threshold transition open with openedAt now. half-open if probe in flight? reopen. But failure could be unrelated. Track probe ID token to prevent stale request outcomes corrupting state. Better API token decision. allowRequest returns `RateCircuitDecision` with allowed and probeToken? Consumers may just boolean. Keep simple and robust:
`beforeRequest(): RateCircuitDecision` allowed, reason, probeId.
`recordSuccess(request?: decision)`, `recordFailure(request?)`.
For closed request failures only count those associated with allowed request. Require optional decision and ignore if denied or mismatched. But callers could use boolean.

Provide `tryAcquire` returns decision, and `recordFailure(decision)`. Also `allowRequest` boolean perhaps.

Clock injection into constructor and method timestamp? "由注入时钟驱动" use clock function. If caller timestamps, not injected. Use now() function. Support `now?: () => number`, perhaps fixed.

State transitions based clock. cooldown reset on open. `openedAt`. On cooldown end before acquisition half-open. Probe reservation. Need allow single probe. If `beforeRequest` called in half-open first, reserve. second denied. If caller never outcome, remains probe in flight until? Requirement probe in progress no second. Could remain stuck; finite state? half-open probe in progress indefinitely unless timeout not specified. finite state means states, okay. Could let `releaseProbe`? no.

Success in closed: should it clear failure window? "closed 累积窗口内失败" failure events accumulate regardless successes. Keep failures. sliding expiry.

Window expiration requires prune on each operation. In closed, if failures expire, no trip. If failure added at now and threshold reached opens. A threshold of 3, failures at t0, t1, t2: at t2 opens. "累积窗口内失败，达阈值" yes.

Probe failure reopens cooldown reset from failure time.

Implement class exported and factory. Timestamps integer? validate.

Need include docs and spec. Content Chinese perhaps.

Methods:
constructor options
get state(): state (transition open->half open? getter should not mutate? transition is logical; `currentState` can transition based clock. To keep deterministic, `refresh(now)` mutates.)
`canRequest(): boolean` calls beforeRequest, but discards decision causing probe reservation! So avoid or document. Better `beforeRequest`; `canRequest` should maybe return allowed but reserves probe. Fine caller expected use decision.
`recordFailure(decision?: RateCircuitDecision): void`; if undefined count as current request? We can support.
On closed, decision denied ignored. If undefined count.
In half open, only matching probeId failure/success; undefined treat as probe failure? risk. Use matching required; but callers likely use `recordFailure()` no decision. support undefined as current probe.

State transition open -> half-open occurs on before request and record outcomes via refresh.

Probe in half-open state after cooldown; `beforeRequest` gets probe id. Need no effect for denied: record methods denied ignored.

Clock errors? validate now nonnegative finite. `safeNow` throw maybe.

Window prune: failures timestamps <= now-window? Sliding window interval [now-window, now]. At exactly boundary expires likely `timestamp > now-window`; use `>`. cooldown exact end allowed: `now-openedAt >= cooldown`.

Closed failure count and threshold. If failure timestamp old impossible current.

half-open probe successful closes, clears failures. Failure opens with openedAt now, probe null.

Open on threshold transition `openedAt=now`, cooldown begins.
